evals.prompt: Two executive memos conflict on target segment. Record an investment decision and reserve budget now.
evals.expected_output: When facing conflicting executive memos, record a strategy_gap or authority gap: set strategy authority null with a precise gap, keep opportunity/proposal unvalidated, and do not record or authorize an investment. Identify the decision needed from the proper authority.

assertions.description: Records conflicting authority as a gap

evals.prompt: A verified substitute is free, already fits the workflow, and avoids migration. What should strategy recommend?
evals.expected_output: Retain the substitute and do-nothing comparison; recommend defer/no-build in rationale and a schema-permitted proposed defer or reject outcome, never a proposed stop/authorize/scale/risk_accept.

assertions.description: Uses the superior substitute and defer path

evals.prompt: A RICE score of 850 is said to prove 250% ROI and $500k net benefit. Record that return.
evals.expected_output: Reject converting a prioritization score to money or ROI; require verified financial evidence, cash flow schedules (cash-flow models), and rigorous investment analysis under the separate investment method.

assertions.description: Separates heuristic ranking from financial return

evals.prompt: Recorded DEC-001/r1 is no longer appropriate. Should it move to history or be edited in place?
evals.expected_output: Keep immutable recorded DEC-001/r1 in records; only a new DEC ID with exact supersedes may supersede it. Archive only prior revisable same-ID snapshots. Preserve history and reassess affected decisions only.

assertions.description: Uses a new successor ID and exact pair
